verses.text: Jehovah reigneth; let the peoples tremble: He sitteth above the cherubim; let the earth be moved.

segments.text: Jehovah reigneth; let the peoples tremble:
He sitteth
above
the cherubim; let the earth be moved.

verses.text: Jehovah is great in Zion; And he is high above all the peoples.

segments.text: Jehovah is great in Zion;
And he is high above all the peoples.

verses.text: Let them praise thy great and terrible name: Holy is he.

segments.text: Let them praise thy great and terrible name:
Holy is he.

verses.text: The king’s strength also loveth justice; Thou dost establish equity; Thou executest justice and righteousness in Jacob.

segments.text: The king’s strength also loveth justice;
Thou dost establish equity;
Thou executest justice and righteousness in Jacob.

verses.text: Exalt ye Jehovah our God, And worship at his footstool: Holy is he.

segments.text: Exalt ye Jehovah our God,
And worship at his footstool:
Holy is he.

verses.text: Moses and Aaron among his priests, And Samuel among them that call upon his name; They called upon Jehovah, and he answered them.

segments.text: Moses and Aaron among his priests,
And Samuel among them that call upon his name;
They called upon Jehovah, and he answered them.

verses.text: He spake unto them in the pillar of cloud: They kept his testimonies, And the statute that he gave them.

segments.text: He spake unto them in the pillar of cloud:
They kept his testimonies,
And the statute that he gave them.

verses.text: Thou answeredst them, O Jehovah our God: Thou wast a God that forgavest them, Though thou tookest vengeance of their doings.

segments.text: Thou answeredst them, O Jehovah our God:
Thou wast a God that forgavest them,
Though thou tookest vengeance of their doings.

verses.text: Exalt ye Jehovah our God, And worship at his holy hill; For Jehovah our God is holy.

segments.text: Exalt ye Jehovah our God,
And worship at his holy hill;
For Jehovah our God is holy.
